none: PAS NLM-E868E5: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: (--)CONSTANTINVS(--). Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORI] A EXER [CITVS]. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.01gms, die axis: 6
